content.title: University ko email?
content.subtitle: Ek saaf email ka jawab jaldi aata hai.

steps.title: Clear subject line
steps.detail: Course ka naam aur sawaal ek line mein. Jaise: MS Data Science, document query.

steps.title: Pehle website padho
steps.detail: Jo jawab FAQ mein likha hai, wo poochne se pehle ek baar dekh lo.

steps.title: Chhota rakho
steps.detail: Apna naam, application ID aur ek clear sawaal. Lambi kahani nahi.

steps.title: Polite tone
steps.detail: Dear Admissions Team se shuru karo, thank you ke saath khatam karo.

steps.title: Sahi time pe follow up
steps.detail: Jawab na aaye toh kuch working days ruko, phir ek chhota reminder bhejo.
steps.tip: Professional email ID use karo, nickname wali nahi.

caption:
University ko email likhna hai par samajh nahi aa raha kaise? Ye 5 rules 👇

1. Clear subject line
2. Pehle website padho
3. Chhota rakho
4. Polite tone
5. Sahi time pe follow up

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
